test_title: PYST 9: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Mr. Arvind was **__accused of beating up before the__** student in the class.

options.text: accused of beating up off the
accused of beating up of the
accused of beating up in the

solution:
The correct answer is: **accused of beating up a**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence is missing the indefinite article **"a"** before the word** "student." **
 
• In English, we use articles before singular countable nouns.
 
• The phrase **"accused of beating up before the"** is awkward and unclear.
 
• The revised sentence restructures this part to make it clear that Mr. Arvind was accused of beating up a student, and it happened in front of the entire class.
 
• **"Beating up"** means physically assaulting someone, often repeatedly and aggressively.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

Correct sentence__: ***Mr. Arvind was __**accused of beating up a**__ student in the class.*
